column1: # UNGRADED.tsv -- jcon_tests: shipped, GRADABLE, ref not cut yet. This file must reach zero rows.
# THE PACKAGE LOCKDOWN (Lon 2026-09-06). Columns: path <TAB> CLASS <TAB> what is owed (lib_inventory.sh).
# EMPTY ON PURPOSE, 2026-09-07 (cfo): the sole row, link1.icn NEEDS_RUNNER_WIRING, is WIRED and GRADED. The
# runner now reads the modules a program `link`s from the program itself and builds it two-file in both modes,
# takes its argv from `link1.args` (a b c), and grades against `link1.ref`, cut from the shared icont/iconx
# oracle (/home/resources/icon-master) with that argv: `{{ a }} / {{ b }} / {{ c }}` on three lines, rc=0,
# byte-stable across two runs. Upstream ships no link1.std; `.ref` and `.args` are ours and say so in README.md.
# ⭐ FROM OUTSIDE_ARIZONA_BASELINE.tsv 2026-09-09 (hq_P, ceo CEO-470). TIMEOUT is WORK OWED, not a ruling:
# Arizona icont compiles both and it is OUR 30-second cap the run does not fit inside, so a bigger cap or a
# faster runtime brings them back. That is why they are here and not in UNGRADABLE.tsv -- the ceo's ruling
# is explicit that they are TIMEOUT-class and NOT oracle-refused.
# ⛔⭐ 2026-09-10 hq_P (ceo CEO-491, on Lon's order): lgint.icn and toby.icn LEFT this file for the GRADED
# population -- they are not work owed, they are reds with an owner (hq_I). Their vendored lgint.std/toby.std are

# and still wrong in a way worth keeping: toby's oracle was never SLOW, it was WRONG (Arizona's `to` wraps past
# 9223372036854775807 and never stops), and a cap cannot tell a defect from a long run. Do not re-add them.
# ⛔⭐ 2026-09-10 hq_P (ceo CEO-487): geddump htprep prepro ARRIVED HERE FROM UNGRADABLE.tsv, where they sat as
